title: Book Three · Chapter 49: The Window and the New City
story:
On Monday afternoon, Anna comes to the hall with Lin, her friend from her old school.

They spent the morning at the small museum. Anna has three pages of drawings. Lin has a folded sheet from the entrance desk.

Ronan introduces Leo. Anna shakes his hand, then looks at his bag.

“Is the corner fixed?”

Leo stares. Then he looks at Ronan.

“You told her about my bag?”

“Only that your aunt wanted it empty.”

Leo laughs and lifts the bottom corner.

“She won. It is empty and fixed.”

They sit on the low wall outside the hall. Anna opens her notebook. Ronan sees the familiar wide window and his crooked door.

“His door?” Leo asks.

Anna nods.

“I know his pots and rice bags,” Leo says. “The door is new.”

Ronan moves a little on the wall. “The door has a good handle.”

“It does,” Anna says. She closes that page and shows them a museum staircase.

Lin points to a shape at the top.

“There was a window here too. You missed it.”

Anna looks closely, then adds a small mark.

Leo studies the drawing. “Our bus station has a roof with glass in it. You can see the sky from the seats.”

Anna turns toward him.

“Does the rain make a loud sound?”

“Very loud. My aunt says we can hear the weather before we go outside.”

Anna laughs. Lin asks about the shops near the station. Leo tells them about the cups outside his window too.

For a while, the three talk. Ronan listens. He knows this hall and the road home. Leo has another city to put beside them.

He looks at the empty space on Anna's page.

Leo turns to him. “You need to visit. Then you can draw that roof.”

“It may fall down on the paper.”

“Only on the paper,” Anna says.

They all laugh. Ronan feels his shoulders loosen.

Lin folds the museum sheet and checks the time. She and Anna need to take a book back before the library closes.

“Tomorrow morning?” Ronan asks.

“We are running in the park,” Anna says. “We can stop near your game after that.”

She writes down the title of the book she borrowed. It has a station on one page. Leo can look for the book in his own city.

“Tell me if it looks like your roof,” she says.

The girls leave together. Ronan and Leo stay at the wall for another minute.

“She really likes windows,” Leo says.

“And other parts.”

Leo smiles. Ronan picks up his bottle and looks down the road.

The afternoon is still hot. They have time for a slow walk before Leo goes back to his grandmother's.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

staircase＝楼梯；roof＝屋顶；loosen＝放松、松开；title＝书名、标题。

## 理解问题

1. Anna和Lin上午做了什么？她们的下午是否一直由Ronan来安排？
2. Ronan为什么有一会儿安静下来？Leo后来怎样把他带回谈话中？

## 读句子

**Ronan feels his shoulders loosen.**

拆开看：Ronan / feels / his shoulders loosen.

Ronan／感觉到／自己的肩膀放松下来。
